feature_name: HTTP/HTTPS Proxy Support for GKE on AWS Management Traffic
summary: Traffic between the GKE on AWS management service and Connect can now be routed through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy.
extended_definition: Traffic between the GKE on AWS management service and Connect can now be routed through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy.

evidence_snippets: See https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/cpu-management-policies/ The following values are allowed. "none": the default, which represents the existing scheduling behavior. "static": allows pods with certain resource characteristics to be granted increased CPU affinity and exclusivity on the node.
Proxy configuration for outbound HTTP(S) traffic. configEncryption object ( AwsConfigEncryption ) Required.
This option is enabled by default which makes kubelet use CFS quota ( https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/scheduler/sched-bwc.txt ) to enforce container CPU limits.
